name: BookOrbit
tagline: Your self-hosted reading space for books, audiobooks, and comics
description: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It syncs progress and highlights across the web reader, Kobo, and KOReader, with metadata lookup, reading stats, OPDS, and multi-user OIDC support.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Jwt secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Setup bootstrap token
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  app:
    container_name: big-bear-bookorbit
    image: ghcr.io/bookorbit/bookorbit:3.2.0@sha256:1020eef9f004be972ac60e79dd5f416129f0d3d91491b803aa8fa656acb2b6a6
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
      APP_URL: http://[YOUR_CASAOS_LAN_IP]:3000
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRES_USER: bookorbit
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: bookorbit
      JWT_SECRET: ${SECRET_JWT_SECRET}
      SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: ${SECRET_SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN}
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      LIBRARY_BROWSE_ROOT: /books
      BOOK_DOCK_PATH: ""
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./books:/books
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - CHOWN
      - DAC_OVERRIDE
      - FOWNER
      - SETGID
      - SETUID
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "const p=process.env.PORT||3000;fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+p+'/api/v1/health').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
  postgres:
    container_name: big-bear-bookorbit-postgres
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg18@sha256:2358fcba361ed2233a5ed81b5fe4ca779ccb304120ce531a3bf51c0ed7e2bc11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: bookorbit
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: bookorbit
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgresql:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U bookorbit -d bookorbit"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 20s
notes:
📚 BOOKORBIT SETUP

1. Place your book files in the ./books folder next to the compose file, or point the bind mount at an existing library path.
2. Update APP_URL to your server's actual address after install so Kobo sync and emails work.
3. After starting, open http://your-server-ip:3000 and complete setup using SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN from docker-compose.yml.

The app container runs read-only with dropped capabilities for security.
